offering_description.value: Designs, sources and markets apparel and accessories under licensed and owned brands, mainly to department stores, specialty retailers and off-price chains. It also sells through its own retail stores and e-commerce sites. Products are made by third-party contract manufacturers.

primary_products.value: men's and women's outerwear; dresses; sportswear; suits; footwear, handbags and accessories

customer_segment.value: B2B: department stores, specialty retailers, off-price retailers, and mass merchants buying wholesale; B2C: shoppers buying through company-operated stores and e-commerce sites

end_markets.value: apparel; fashion accessories; footwear; sports and lifestyle licensed merchandise

revenue_model.value: product sales: wholesale apparel and accessories sold to retailers; product sales: direct-to-consumer sales through own stores and websites

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: designs and markets owned and licensed brands, using third-party manufacturers, selling to retailers and consumers; retailer: operates outlet and brand stores and e-commerce sites selling to consumers

geography_served.value: global: Primarily United States, with sales in Canada, Europe and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: apparel, footwear and accessories across owned and licensed brands

distribution_channels.value: third-party retail: department stores, specialty stores, off-price and mass retailers; own locations: company-operated outlet and brand stores; online: company-owned brand e-commerce sites

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Customs and import tariffs, product safety and labeling rules, and labor standards in sourcing
